_help: Shared events that hit the whole family when a year passes. cond uses family variables (see README). 'each' = effects for every living sibling (optionally filtered with each_cond). 'family' = family-wide changes. sib_rel_all changes every sibling-to-sibling relationship.
_seasons: Optional "seasons": [1-4] limits an event to Winter (1), Spring (2), Summer (3) or Fall (4) when playing in quarters.

events.text: 💔 {mom} and {dad} are getting divorced. The house feels quiet.
💒 Plot twist! {mom} and {dad} got back together!
🚚 The {last} family is moving to {newplace}!
🏖️ Surprise! The parents took the whole family on a trip to {destination}!
🐾 The family adopted a {petkind} named {petname}! {petemoji}
🌈 The family {petkind} {petname} crossed the rainbow bridge.
📜 Great-Aunt Gertrude left the {last} family {amount}! The siblings need to decide how to split it.
📈 {parent} got a big promotion at work!
📉 {parent} lost their job. Money is tight this year.
🎲 Family game night got WAY too competitive. Someone flipped the board.
👵 Grandma came to visit and brought a mountain of cookies!
🌊 The basement flooded! Everyone's old toys floated away.

🎉 Big {last} family reunion! Everyone came home for the weekend.
🏥 {parent} is in the hospital for a while.
